title: Solution Space Partitioning for Extremal Set Theory
summary: We present a method for partitioning the solution space of statements in extremal set theory. Compared with domain-agnostic partitioning methods like look-ahead, we perform case analysis on the strategies by which a candidate solution can be constructed. We demonstrate that our approach can decompose problems in extremal set theory more effectively than look-ahead.
